status: Primary code tables and conventions visually verified; digital 000 bridge and doc_count semantics not authenticated

source.title: The Indus Script: Texts, Concordance and Tables
source.author: Iravatham Mahadevan

object_type_codes.note: No code8 appears in the primary table; do not invent its meaning

values.3: Single sign in the line of text
values.9: Doubtful because of damaged or illegible signs

direction_codes.reference_surface: Seal impressions; originals of other inscribed objects (note4)

values.0: Only line of text on side
values.9: No line of text; only a field symbol

reference_layout.continuations: Text/type omitted for extra sides; text/type/side/field-symbol omitted for extra lines on same side

normalization.seal_orientation: Copied as impressions; other objects copied from originals
normalization.printed_line_direction: Every line normalized right to left, independently of actual direction recorded in the direction code
normalization.sign_orientation: Normalized signary; variants not distinguished in Texts, Concordance and Tables; asymmetric signs printed in normal orientation
normalization.consequence: Do not reverse a digital sequence solely from its direction label until digital serialization relative to the normalized page is authenticated

damage_conventions.asterisk: Doubtfully read sign; printed at top right of sign
damage_conventions.hatched_block: Illegible or lost passage containing one or more signs; number of lost signs is not recoverable from the block
damage_conventions.000: Not a printed primary convention on these pages. Digital representation is upstream-specific and requires a separate transformation check
damage_conventions.zero_notation_distinctions: Side0, line0, direction0 and field-symbol00 have different defined metadata meanings; none establishes a numerical value or sign000
damage_conventions.digital_canonical_observation: Example1001 uses raw_signs token0 and diplomatic000; this demonstrates digital padding but does not independently authenticate its correspondence to the primary hatched block

primary_corpus_definition.symbol_only_sides: Listed separately in Texts but not included in Concordance

doc_count_review.status: Undocumented upstream field; do not decode from numerical range alone

witness.last_line: Wholly illegible; retained because other lines of text are legible
